in_marathi.name: Durgeswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortresses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgeswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘durga’ (fortress) and ‘iswar’ (lord), Durgeswar represents the lord of all fortresses or the protector. In Hindu mythology, Durga is a powerful goddess and the embodiment of female energy, and Durgeswar is her male counterpart.
